name: Oath of Loyalty
source:
Set in "Dover City", the game follows a young man about to graduate from university. What choices will he make while he is caught up within criminal organizations, citywide corruption and love triangles? In the end, just what kind of person will he be? You decide.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/oathofloyalty]Patreon[/url]]
